digest.component_or_area: plan-review acceptance criteria tagging and verification
propositions: The canonical tag `[operator-attested]` must be renamed to `[non-codebase]` to clarify that the tag names WHERE evidence lives (outside codebase) rather than WHO attests (operator vs agent).

Both tag spellings `[non-codebase]` and `[operator-attested]` must be recognized by the deterministic matcher as non-capturing alternation `\[(?:non-codebase|operator-attested)\]` to preserve backward compatibility for 827 existing tickets and avoid breaking findall() arity.

The `kind` wire value in completion verdicts must be cut over from `operator-attested` to `non-codebase` in lockstep across emitters (contracts.py, schema, prompts) and reader (audit/page.py:329), with reader widened first so legacy verdicts keep rendering.
The `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` activation trigger must be widened to match both tag spellings so `[non-codebase]`-tagged plans fire `project.measurement-provenance` criterion.
Author-facing documentation and guidance must emit only `[non-codebase]` with `[operator-attested]` retained as undocumented compatibility alias and never appearing in documented surfaces.

The regex `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` object must remain shared across five consumers (decide_ops, workflow_ops, det_attestation_launder, det_measurement_provenance, txn.py) with identical semantics to propagate widening everywhere without code duplication.
